Requirement / User Story: As an analyst, I need a reproducible batch of pacs.008 messages so I can compare results across runs.
Given: rapide is built and application.yaml is configured
When: A run is started with -n 5000 and seed 42
Then: 5,000 files appear in raw/run-001/; re-running with seed 42 gives identical files

Requirement / User Story: As an analyst, I need known defects injected so detection accuracy can be measured.
When: The injector runs at a 10% rate
Then: About 500 messages are mutated; one INJECTED_DEFECT row per mutation

Requirement / User Story: As an analyst, I need every message checked against the pacs.008 XSD so malformed messages are rejected.
When: A message missing a mandatory element is validated
Then: Outcome is Schema error with R-SCH-01 and the element's XPath

Requirement / User Story: As an analyst, I need clean messages to pass so I am not chasing false alarms.
Then: Outcome is Valid; no rule failures

Requirement / User Story: As an analyst, I need identifier formats checked (BIC, IBAN, UETR) so routing does not fail.
Given: A message with an IBAN whose check digits are wrong
Then: R-FMT-02 fails with the IBAN's XPath; the IBAN is masked in the output

Requirement / User Story: As an analyst, I need currency and amount rules checked so settlement amounts are correct.
Given: A JPY message with a decimal amount

Requirement / User Story: As an analyst, I need header totals reconciled so batch counts match.
Given: NbOfTxs or CtrlSum disagrees with the transactions

Requirement / User Story: As an analyst, I need charge bearer and purpose codes checked against allowed lists.
Given: A message with charge bearer XXXX

Requirement / User Story: As an analyst, I need duplicate messages flagged so a payment is not sent twice.
Given: Two messages in a run share a UETR

Requirement / User Story: As a reviewer, I need account numbers masked in logs and API output so sensitive data is not exposed.
Given: A run containing IBANs has completed
When: Logs and API responses are searched for full IBANs
Then: No full IBAN is found; only the last four characters appear

Requirement / User Story: As a reviewer, I need every result traceable to run, message, rule and code version.
Then: RunId, MessageId, RuleId and CodeVersion are present

Requirement / User Story: As a reviewer, I need RTM coverage shown in Power BI so untested requirements are visible.
When: The RTM coverage page is opened
Then: Each requirement shows Passed, Failed or Not run

Requirement / User Story: As a developer, I need to validate a single message over the API.
Given: The API is running and I hold a valid key
When: I POST a valid message to /validate

Requirement / User Story: As a developer, I need batch and API results to agree.
Given: The same message is in a batch run
Then: Both return the same outcome and failed rules

Requirement / User Story: As the system, the API must reject unauthenticated requests.
When: A request is sent with no key or token
Then: 401 Unauthorized; nothing is validated or logged with message content

Requirement / User Story: As the system, the API must block XML external entity (XXE) payloads.
When: A message with an external entity declaration is sent
Then: Request rejected; no external resource is fetched

Requirement / User Story: As the system, the API must reject oversized payloads.
As a tester, I need throughput measured by consumer count to show the gain from parallelism.
When: The worker runs at 1, 2, 4 and 8 consumers
Then: Messages per second recorded for each; results identical across runs

Requirement / User Story: As a tester, I need API latency measured under load.
When: NBomber runs steady, spike and soak scenarios
Then: p50, p95 and p99 latency and error rate are recorded
